    reader = csv.DictReader(f)

zones = set()
for r in rows:
    uri = r['point_uri']
    # Extract the zone part (before the dot)
    if '#' in uri:
        part = uri.split('#')[-1]
        if '.' in part:
            zone = part.split('.')[0]
            zones.add(zone)
        else:
            zones.add(part)

print("All zones found:")
for z in sorted(zones):
    print(f"  {z}")
